translation:
(紫石英 (zǐshíyīng) is its envoy; it fears 理石 (lǐshí), 李核 (lǐhé), and 杏仁 (xìngrén).)

The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 白芨 (báijí), flavor bitter, neutral. It governs carbuncle swelling, malignant sores, and decaying carbuncles (癰腫惡瘡敗疽), injury of yin and dead flesh (傷陰死肌), evil-qi in the stomach (胃中邪氣), thief-wind and ghost-strike (賊風鬼擊), and prickly-heat (痱)...
